_comment: 1.45 Thoughtful Parcels. Need picks what a parcel holds, never how much: a parcel's worth is value.base + value.perLevel x the level it was earned at, capped at value.max, times share for what earned it. Items count at their sell price (silver and gold at the star price); what does not fit comes as coins. lineShare: at most this share of what is missing from a project line or an upgrade. repeatDays: an item comes at most once in this many days (a pinned goal is exempt). low: when feed and bait count as running low.
